purpose: Teach: 陶器/アミノ酸/音符/管弦楽/画素/サンダル/ギタリスト/リアクション

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの陶器のお皿、大事にしてね
lines.en: Sho, take good care of Grandma's ceramic plate, won't you.
lines.style: Gentle, protective tone. A soft instruction wrapped in affection. Slight pause before the request, as if imparting something precious. Warm but steady — this matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お肉のアミノ酸が栄養って習ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned that the amino acids in meat are nutrition.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery with a small lift at the start. Pride in the new fact he's learned. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm. No performance — just a kid sharing something he discovered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ピアノの音符をママと一緒に覚えましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's learn the piano notes together, you and me.
lines.style: Warm invitation, unhurried. Slight emphasis on 「一緒に」 — the togetherness is the point. Patient, encouraging tone. Relaxed but attentive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと管弦楽の演奏会に行きたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to an orchestra concert with Dad.
lines.style: Direct, genuine request with underlying excitement. Quick opening. Earnest without being demanding. The kind of wanting that's honest, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのカメラは画素が高いのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's camera has quite high resolution.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant tone. A small observation she's turning over. Not directed at him entirely — more thinking aloud. Gentle, but somewhere else for a moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、夏休みのサンダル買って欲しい
lines.en: Mom, will you buy me sandals for summer vacation?
lines.style: Direct, unself-conscious request. Quick, eager opening. Natural child's timing — not precious, just asking what he wants. Simple, straightforward.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお友達のギタリスト、お見えになるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's friend — the guitarist — will be visiting.
lines.style: Gentle, informational tone with a hint of knowing amusement. Not quite offering it as a surprise, but as news that lands. Calm delivery, slightly warm undertone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのジョークに大きなリアクションしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I gave Dad's joke a big reaction.
lines.style: Bright, slight pride in the memory. Quick, genuine delivery. A small accomplishment in his own eyes. Warm closing with natural child-like directness.
